entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while I connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana, I'm calling about an order I placed a couple of months ago. I bought a pair of road cycling shoes and I'd like to return them.
I can certainly look into that for you. To understand the situation better, can I ask what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference or fit issue?

It's a fit issue. I've tried to make them work, adjusted the cleats a few times, but they keep giving me terrible blisters after any ride longer than an hour. They just don't seem to be the right shape for my feet.

I'm sorry to hear that the cycling shoes are causing blisters; that's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Could I get your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order. It looks like the shoes were delivered about 60 days ago. Let me just check our policy.
Alright, I've confirmed it. Our policy allows for returns up to 90 days after delivery, so you're well within the window. I can go ahead and process this return for a full refund for you.

Oh, that's great news. I appreciate you making that easy. Since I did have to go through the trouble and now have to repackage everything, is there any possibility of getting a small discount code for a future purchase? I'd like to try a different model.

I understand your request. While I'm glad I can authorize the refund, I am not able to provide a discount code in this situation. However, I am sending the pre-paid return label to your email right now. As soon as we receive the shoes back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
Okay, that's fair. Getting the refund is the most important part. Thank you for your help, Diana.
You're very welcome. The email with the label should be in your inbox shortly. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
